fields.description: Issue includes an editorial condemning a Dade County grand jury gambling investigation as politically motivated, criticizing State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne and discussing Miami Beach politics and alleged selective indictments. Also covers local sports and entertainment, including Hialeah Park racing commentary and tips by “Jockey Jimmy,” the closing of the Biscayne Kennel Club meet, and a feature on a Miami Beach walkathon. Additional columns and advertisements reference Bruno Richard Hauptmann and the Lindbergh case, nightlife venues, and local businesses.
